gloss: to hang; to phone; to pour; to spend; to lock

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: かけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to hang; to put over (a cover)
definitions.explanation: To hang something on a hook, wall or hanger (a picture, a coat, a bag on a chair), or to lay a cover over something, as when putting a blanket over a sleeping child. Pattern: YにXをかける.
To phone someone. The call is the object and the person called takes に: {友達|ともだち}に{電話|でんわ}をかける. The receiving side is expressed with かかる: {電話|でんわ}がかかってくる (a call comes in).
To put on or wear glasses or sunglasses. かけている describes wearing them as a state: {眼鏡|めがね}をかけている{人|ひと} (a person who wears glasses).

To pour, sprinkle or spread a liquid or powder over something: soy sauce or a sauce on food, bonito flakes on tofu, water on someone, a glaze on pottery. Pattern: YにXをかける, where Y is the thing covered.

To spend or invest time, money or effort on something, usually a generous or deliberate amount: {時間|じかん}をかける, お{金|かね}をかける, {長|なが}い{年月|ねんげつ}をかけて. A bare amount also works: {一|いっ}か{月|げつ}かけて (taking a whole month).

definitions.gloss: to cause (worry, trouble); to speak to
definitions.explanation: To direct something at another person, who is marked with に: to cause them trouble or worry ({迷惑|めいわく}をかける, {心配|しんぱい}をかける), or to address words to them ({声|こえ}をかける, {一声|ひとこえ}かける). The humble form おかけする is common in apologies.
To lock something or fasten it shut: {鍵|かぎ}をかける (lock), ボタンをかける (do up a button), ロックをかける (lock a phone or a file). The resulting state is expressed with かかる: {鍵|かぎ}がかかっている (it is locked).

definitions.gloss: to start, to run, to apply (an engine, brakes)
definitions.explanation: To set a machine or process going, or bring something to bear: start an engine, apply the brakes, iron clothes, play music, run a search ({検索|けんさく}をかける), cast a spell ({魔法|まほう}をかける), and figuratively put a brake on something ({歯止|はど}めをかける) or call people together ({号令|ごうれい}をかける, {召集|しょうしゅう}をかける).

definitions.gloss: (after a verb stem) to start to; to be about to
definitions.explanation: Attached to the stem of another verb ({言|い}いかける, {忘|わす}れかける), かける means to begin doing something, or to be partway through or on the verge of it, often implying that the action stopped or did not finish. The noun form 〜かけ means half-done: {読|よ}みかけの{本|ほん} (a half-read book). Written in kana.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ (intransitive): ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける → ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧; ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける → ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧くる
- Pattern: (Y⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける

WRITING:
Usually written in kana. The kanji depend on the sense:
- {掛|か}ける: most senses (hang, pour, spend, cause, lock, set going, verb stem + かける)
- {架|か}ける: build a span, as in ⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{架|か}ける (build a bridge)
